div.p: Sonoma County Radio Amateurs, Inc. (SCRA) is a ham radio club with over 200 members. Our mission includes promoting amateur radio education, providing emergency services support, offering training opportunities, and maintaining radio repeater systems.

ul.li: Amateur radio education and community outreach
Repeater system maintenance, providing coverage across Sonoma County and parts of Marin and Lake Counties

div.p: During recent wildfires and PSPS events, SCRA's repeaters remained operational. Following the September 2020 Glass Fire, which destroyed the Castle Rock repeater station (valued at $14,000), community donations enabled its restoration by October 2021.

SCRA is a 501(c)(3) charitable organization (Federal ID 68-0005765). Donations are tax deductible to the full extent permitted by law. Donation receipts are available upon request with contact information.

ul.li: Check, made payable to "Sonoma County Radio Amateurs, Inc.", mailed to PO Box 116, Santa Rosa, CA 95402-0116
Tangible amateur radio-related goods - contact Curt Helstrom WA6TIP at curth@sonic.net for details
